the distributed application paradigm is to provide the application developer with the illusion that he is developing a centralized application.
the development paradigm for distributed applications should be based on the notion of the distributed application itself rather than on the underlying network.

the development of a general support environment to the ideal development paradigm of distributed systems.
the design of the general support mechanism of the ideal development paradigm for distributed applications.
a development paradigm and a support environment for it.

we have developed the concept of an ideal development paradigm, a general mechanism for its implementation, and an example implementation for an environment based on Sun RPC.
we have developed a general support environment for a development paradigm of distributed application, which facilitates the implementation of distributed application.
we have developed the concept and the basic mechanism of a general support environment for distributed applications and the implementation for the RPC environment.

the development of distributed applications should be as simple as that of centralized applications.
